reasoning_content:
Leaflet core library itself is not in web/libraries. Let me check how leaflet module expects it. The leaflet module usually uses CDN by default or a local library. Let me check leaflet.libraries.yml and settings.

Actually let me check where leaflet core JS comes from.

action.command: cd /workspace && cat web/modules/contrib/leaflet/leaflet.libraries.yml 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== leaflet settings ==="; su ddevuser -c "ddev drush config:get leaflet.settings" 2>&1 | tail -20

tool_call.name: terminal
